terms.gloss: tap the ticket on the reader
terms.comment: A description of ours: hold the ticket to the machine (tesserae, quae māchinae appōnuntur ut porta aperiātur). Traupman has only punching a ticket, tesseram perforāre (p. 218); no reference work has a phrase for tapping one on a reader.

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 218.
